# unifi_hotspot_operator (Resource)

The `unifi_hotspot_operator` resource manages a hotspot operator account in the UniFi controller. Hotspot operators are the accounts used to authorise guests and manage guest hotspot access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A hotspot operator account used to authorise guest hotspot access.
resource "unifi_hotspot_operator" "front_desk" {
  name       = "front-desk"
  note       = "Lobby reception operator"
  x_password = "change-me"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the hotspot operator.

### Optional

- `note` (String) A free-form note for the hotspot operator.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.
- `x_password` (String, Sensitive) The password for the hotspot operator account.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# import using the site name and the hotspot operator ID: <site>:<id>
terraform import unifi_hotspot_operator.front_desk default:5f8b1a2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e
```
